title: Sherlock + Academy
titleNative: シャーロック＋アカデミー
synopsis: The need for detectives has dramatically increased in response to the increasing number of violent crimes. This year, a boy and a girl enter Marimine Detective Academy, an ultra-exclusive school, and the only one in Japan that offers the "National Detective License." The boy is Misaki Fujisaki, the grandson of the man who was once known as the "Crime King." The girl is Shia E. Hazeldine, the adopted daughter of the man known as the "Detective King." These two descendants of sworn enemies will meet each other by chance! And as their school days begin, an incident occurs right from the entrance ceremony!? Moreover, for some reason, Fujisaki's score is higher than Shia's, even though she supposedly solved the mystery first... "I challenge you!" "Don't regret this, princess." This is a unique academy story where students compete to find the truth. This is intellectual excitement at its highest peak! (Source: MFBunko J, translated)

synopsis: A legendary god-tier game, "Dungeon Job Hunting Recommendation", aka "DanKatsu", features an unprecedented 1,021 playable job classes and over 400 different endings! The more you play, the stronger you become, unlocking new abilities and rare items. One dedicated gamer (PN: Zephyrus) finds himself reincarnated as the protagonist of this very game! Overjoyed at the chance to experience it in real life, he immediately enrolls in the Labyrinth Academy—the game's main stage. Armed with his extensive knowledge of the game's mechanics, he aims to obtain the ultimate class: Hero. Not only that, but he also guides his timid childhood friend toward the Alchemist class, allowing the two of them to breeze through the academy's curriculum and rapidly level up! Powerful jobs, legendary loot, and epic rewards—secured at lightning speed! (Source: TO Books, translated)

There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day?
